messages:
Maria: Quick draft for tomorrow's release notes and a pin request — need ops signoff + latch rules. Change window 02:00-05:00 UTC. Please read RN below and flag rollback/thresholds.

Alex: LGTM on copy. Can we pin the model to `redwood/base-7b:v1.2-pin` so auto-upgrades don't sneak in?

Maria: Yep, pin requested. I'll open the infra PR. Rollout plan: canary -> staged -> gradual prod.

Jess: Canary suggestion: start on 5 hosts in staging (10% traffic), hold 30m, then 50% staged for 1h.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary at 02:15 UTC. Command: `/deploy redwood/base-7b:v1.2-pin --canary=5 --window=02:00-05:00`

Sam: Proposed rollback criteria: any of these triggers immediate rollback and incident channel ping — 1) 5xx rate >2% sustained for 10m, 2) p99 latency increase >30% vs baseline for 10m, 3) top-100 eval regression rate >5% (automated evals).

Paul: Add customer-impact rule: if failed requests for paying tenants >0.5% for 5m, escalate to oncall and pause rollout.

Maria: Updated RN copy below — paste for internal announce and for the release notes repo: 

```
- Faster KV-cache priming for session reuse (reduces cold-start latency)
- Improved batching heuristics — estimated 8-20% token-cost reduction for typical workloads
- Fix: tokenization edge-case for certain emoji sequences
Known issue: embeddings endpoint may return occasional duplicate ids under heavy load (workaround: dedupe client-side)
```

Jess: For internal announce please call out the Known issue as a prominent callout and include regional rollout map (us-west, eu-central).

ops-bot: Reminder: pin must be reflected in infra-config. PR #4872 created by @Maria for `model_pins.yml`.

Maria: PR link: https://git.internal/r/4872 — tagging @oncall to standby for the window. Will post internal announce at 01:30 UTC.

Alex: I'll be oncall for 02:00-05:00 UTC. If we need to rollback I'll post the decision, time, and trigger `/rollback redwood/base-7b:v1.2-pin`.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 02:15 UTC (canary thread 1741240200). Status: 5/5 hosts healthy, initial healthchecks green.

Sam: Metrics @ +20m look stable. No 5xx spike, p99 within expected variance. Proceeding to staged rollout to 50% at 03:00 UTC.

Jess: Draft internal announce copy for 01:30 post: "Tomorrow 02:00 UTC — rolling deploy to staging then gradual to prod. Pin: redwood/base-7b:v1.2-pin. Rollback criteria: 5xx >2% for 10m, p99 +30%, eval regressions >5%. See internal RN for details and infra PR #4872."

Maria: Sounds good. Also adding the latch rule: we hold the pin (no unpin/autoupgrades) for 24h after full prod rollout. Latch expiration = 24h post 100% with no alerts.

Paul: Agree on 24h latch. Also add that business-critical tenants get a heads-up email if we hit any of the lower thresholds.

Alex: Ack. I'll escalate to infra if GPU pool utilization >85% during rollout.

ops-bot: Deploy completed to prod at 04:45 UTC. No rollback required, metrics within thresholds. Closing the window.

Maria: Thanks team — I'll merge RN into the release branch and post the internal announcement at 01:30 UTC as planned. If anyone wants changes to the RN wording, ping me now. :thumbsup:

marketing: Noted — will prepare the public snippet but will wait until latch expires before publishing.

Alex: closing watch. Good run.
